subject: Official library for our stack, and where timing guarantees are published
body: Two quick ones before we finalise our design. Do you publish an official library for our language, or is everybody just writing raw HTTP calls against the endpoints? I would rather not hand roll the signature verification if there is something maintained. Second, our architect wants a written statement on how quickly a notification is expected to arrive after the underlying thing happens, and what you commit to on delivery timing generally. I have dug through the webhooks section and the error tables and cannot find either of these documented. Point me at the right page if it exists.
